Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

The only official Berserk OS from Militech. Its genius lies in being nanopowered, making it highly suited for regenerative purposes.

Berserk Operating System. Berserk now counts as Borgware for Max Humanity Loss. Berserk can now be activated without an Action and its duration is reduced to 12 seconds (4 Rounds). Non-FBC users without a Cyberspine suffer 1d6 Humanity Loss every time they activate Berserk, and a -4 penalty to Ranged Attacks while active.

While Berserk is active, all suffered HP damage is reduced by half (Round Up), and any of the following Actions may be done as half of a ROF 2 Action: Equip/Drop Shield, Get Up, Grab, Human Shield, Stabilize (yourself only), Use an Object (e.g., Street Drugs or Pharmaceuticals), and Actions taken to activate an item or cyberware, clear a jam, put yourself out while On Fire, or stow a weapon. Brawling or Martial Arts Aimed Shots can be made at ROF 2 if the user could not already do so.

After Berserk’s duration ends, the user recovers 5 HP (This cannot put them beyond their maximum HP), and it cannot be activated again for an hour unless the user voluntarily suffers 3 Humanity Loss per consecutive activation before an hour passes (e.g., 3 -> 6 -> 9, etc).

Enhances: Berserk
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Every Operating System is incompatible with every other Operating System and with the base cyberware it is for: none of them can be installed while another OS, or that OS's own base cyberware, is anywhere in the user's body or in a worn apparatus they're connected to. The sheet doesn't enforce that.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Berserk Operating Systems).
